about: Susan M. Lampert attended law school and graduated from Chicago-Kent College of Law, Illinois Institute of Technology in 1992. Susan Lampert began practicing law in 1992.
Susan Lampert is an attorney at Susan Lampert & Associates, helping people with Family Law issues. Susan Lampert & Associates has an office in Deerfield, Illinois, serving the local community.

Susan Lampert was selected to Super Lawyers for 2016 - 2027. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
